atoms.exact_source_text: A Guest does not add a sixth Approach or a generic stat bonus.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Guest does not add a sixth Approach or a generic stat bonus.

atoms.exact_source_text: Guests light existing options, reinterpret terrain, open routes, or make a consequence bearable.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guests function by lighting existing options, reinterpreting terrain, opening routes, or making a consequence bearable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species difference should appear as new possibility inside shared systems.
atoms.normalized_claim: Species difference should appear as new possibility inside shared systems.

atoms.exact_source_text: Purpose, willing Citizens, Home share removed, resulting margins, one Supply choice, known route constraints
atoms.normalized_claim: The Launch view must show purpose, willing Citizens, Home share removed, resulting margins, one Supply choice, and known route constraints.

atoms.exact_source_text: Unrevealed contest, exact odds, hidden aptitude numbers, full inventory optimization.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Launch view must not show unrevealed contest, exact odds, hidden aptitude numbers, or full inventory optimization.

atoms.exact_source_text: Party, route, time/light, load, weather, shelter, known Nodes, descriptive Citizen Conditions
atoms.normalized_claim: The TRAVEL view must show party, route, time/light, load, weather, shelter, known Nodes, and descriptive Citizen Conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tactical spacing, constant event countdowns, invisible return cost.
atoms.normalized_claim: The TRAVEL view must not show tactical spacing, constant event countdowns, or invisible return cost.

atoms.exact_source_text: Lane flow, readable windows, refuges, party cohesion, load burden, immediate descriptive danger
atoms.normalized_claim: The RISK view must show lane flow, readable windows, refuges, party cohesion, load burden, and immediate descriptive danger.

atoms.exact_source_text: Approach strip, turn order, enemy health, exact Exposure meter.
atoms.normalized_claim: The RISK view must not show Approach strip, turn order, enemy health, or exact Exposure meter.

atoms.exact_source_text: Fixed scene, exact party, Presence or Node, stakes, lit/grey Approaches, cargo, relevant Conditions
atoms.normalized_claim: The Away MEET view must show fixed scene, exact party, Presence or Node, stakes, lit/grey Approaches, cargo, and relevant Conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Positioning grid, initiative, targeting, likelihood labels, Spirit bar.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Away MEET view must not show positioning grid, initiative, targeting, likelihood labels, or Spirit bar.

atoms.exact_source_text: Who returned, wounds/Conditions, cargo, Guests, knowledge, receiving Places, Role availability, new margins
atoms.normalized_claim: The Homecoming view must show who returned, wounds/Conditions, cargo, Guests, knowledge, receiving Places, Role availability, and new margins.

atoms.exact_source_text: Expedition score, celebratory grade, automatic invisible absorption.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Homecoming view must not show expedition score, celebratory grade, or automatic invisible absorption.

atoms.exact_source_text: Named Citizen advice remains valuable when the situation makes that Citizen relevant.
atoms.normalized_claim: Named Citizen advice remains valuable when the situation makes that Citizen relevant.

atoms.exact_source_text: Advice frames the threatened value or remembered route; it does not reveal hidden odds.
atoms.normalized_claim: Advice frames the threatened value or remembered route without revealing hidden odds.

atoms.exact_source_text: The same animal may speak at Launch, in MEET, or at Homecoming because one world fact persists across Registers.
atoms.normalized_claim: The same animal may speak at Launch, in MEET, or at Homecoming because one world fact persists across Registers.

atoms.exact_source_text: Use figures for public colony and party quantities—Role Capacity, Load, carry, Citizen-Days, stores, route distance, time.
atoms.normalized_claim: Public colony and party quantities such as Role Capacity, Load, carry, Citizen-Days, stores, route distance, and time use numeric figures.

atoms.exact_source_text: Use descriptive bands and named Conditions for personal health, fear, Exposure, and aptitude.
atoms.normalized_claim: Personal health, fear, Exposure, and aptitude use descriptive bands and named Conditions instead of numbers.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Spirit stat is introduced.
atoms.normalized_claim: No Spirit stat is introduced.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Departure cannot be mandatory suicide.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Departure cannot be mandatory suicide.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Launch preview must make Home subtraction and route burden legible enough for an informed decision.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Launch preview must make Home subtraction and route burden legible enough for an informed decision.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Away content must not erase Home success.** Most expeditions should return something useful, clarifying, or relationship-bearing even when the original objective is not achieved.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away content must not erase Home success; most expeditions should return something useful, clarifying, or relationship-bearing even when the original objective is not achieved.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Cards remain sparse.**
atoms.normalized_claim: Cards remain sparse.

atoms.exact_source_text: Field remains readable territory; authored Nodes carry most intentional content.
atoms.normalized_claim: Field remains readable territory while authored Nodes carry most intentional content.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Crossing remains short.** Difficulty should deepen through pressure, route, load, and consequence—not through a long sequence of twitch obstacles.
atoms.normalized_claim: Crossing remains short; difficulty should deepen through pressure, route, load, and consequence rather than a long sequence of twitch obstacles.
